cases.note: #383 seed 4: the tube (centre (20, 22.5, 25), R 10, r 2.5) is tangent to the box's bottom z = 22.5 along an arc inside that face. Intersection, post-process on. Independent reference: box n torus volume ~165.341 (240^3 midpoint grid), torus area in the box ~112.49. Rust on 2026-10-26 gave the intersection's merged torus face too little area (seed 4: 67.9, seed 86: 24.4 of 40.7).
